question: Should this PR require real Feishu Open Platform proof before merge, or may maintainers accept the mocked-client proof for this media fallback fix?
rationale: The code shape is narrow and source-backed, but repository policy treats external channel/API delivery changes as needing real behavior proof unless maintainers intentionally waive that gap.

options.title: Require live Feishu proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, copied live output, or a short recording from a real Feishu setup showing image/file fallback delivery and unsafe native-thread refusal before merge.

options.title: Accept source-level proof
options.body: A maintainer can intentionally accept the mocked seam proof because the PR reuses the already-shipped text/card fallback helper, while owning the remaining live transport uncertainty.

recommendation.title: Require live Feishu proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, copied live output, or a short recording from a real Feishu setup showing image/file fallback delivery and unsafe native-thread refusal before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the existing fallback contract and is the strongest history-backed owner for deciding whether source-level proof is enough here.
